title: Site-Outage Uplift: Late Hosting Provisioning and the Primary Domain
content:
# Site-outage uplift

> Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the plan's primary domain among the customer's Domain Registrations.

## Clause

The site-outage uplift of the late-provisioning goodwill follows the plan's primary domain: where that domain is an active Harborline domain of the customer using Harborline DNS nameservers, the uplift is $10.00; where it is an active Harborline domain of the customer using external nameservers, the uplift is $4.00; where it is not an active Harborline domain of the customer, no uplift is added. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-provisioning goodwill figure.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Primary domain of the plan | Nameservers on the domain record | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| an active domain the customer holds at Harborline | Harborline DNS | $10.00 |
| an active domain the customer holds at Harborline | external | $4.00 |
| registered elsewhere, or a Harborline domain that is not active | any | none |

## Points of judgement

- A primary domain in its grace period or on hold is not an active domain, so it adds no uplift.
- The test reads the domain's own status and nameserver setting in the domain holding.
